name: com.loopholetape/solana-token-safety
title: loophole tape: Solana token safety
description: Solana token safety and pump.fun rug checks: free for any mint, paid depth in USDC on Solana or Base

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base58 secret key of a wallet holding USDC on Solana; pays the paid tools per call. Use a dedicated wallet with a few dollars. No SOL needed.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key (0x + 64 hex) of an EVM wallet holding USDC on Base; pays when no Solana wallet is set. No ETH needed.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a solana-keygen JSON keypair, instead of SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: LOOPHOLETAPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A prepaid lt_... key, used instead of a wallet.

environmentVariables.name: LOOPHOLETAPE_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most to pay for one call, in USD. Tools priced above it are hidden.

environmentVariables.name: LOOPHOLETAPE_MAX_USD_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Most to sign in one UTC day, in USD.
